review_method: Freshly viewed all101 native480x854 call PNGs using tools.view_image across each of the26 original-resolution2x2 sheets call-01.png through call-26.png; all four quadrants of sheets01-25 and the one frame of sheet26 were inspected. Also individually viewed the third-run original emerald-dark-normal-longname-he, emerald-light-normal-largefont and frost-dark-normal-longname-en PNGs to confirm the bounded caption and name patterns. This is a new review of the exact third-run image bytes, not approval reused from the second run. Recomputed each original SHA-256, verified exact source/tree/run metadata from the current matrix manifest, and verified every sheet frame pixel-for-pixel against its original PNG.

bounded_findings.finding: All20 Hebrew/English long-name captures ellipsize the caller name inside its allotted identity area. The frost/ivory side-avatar normal layouts show stronger truncation. Phone number, timer, avatar and controls remain separate and readable.

At font scale1.3 the Hebrew New call caption is ellipsized in the emerald normal six-control layout: dark/light normal-largefont and dark normal-longname-he. The last file also belongs to the long-name finding, giving22 unique bounded frames in total. The phone-plus icon, other controls and hang-up remain visible, while the matching More-panel captures display the full label.

scope_limits: All101 call-design captures are static fictional call-state fixtures rendered by the production in-app call UI. This visual inspection does not establish real Telecom action acknowledgement or actual audible routing.

The pictured coverage includes five call designs, light/dark variants, normal/audio/more/keypad states, Hebrew/English long names, font scale1.3 and an English no-Bluetooth output chooser. It does not exhaust every possible font, data, theme and device combination.
This visual review does not test a physical Jelly Star, SIM/carrier calls, microphone/speaker/Bluetooth audio, lockscreen/proximity, full TalkBack or a matching-key data-preserving upgrade.
This report covers the current-run call group. Overall candidate approval requires the other fresh current-run visual groups and the independently verified native/test provenance.
